app-deps-install.description: Install the app's npm dependencies for this platform from package-lock.json (deletes and rebuilds app/node_modules).

app-deps-rebuild.description: Rebuild native modules in app/node_modules for this platform.

app-dev-dependency-add.description: Add one dev dependency to app/package.json and package-lock.json.

test-all.description: Run the whole test suite outside your sandbox: backend unit and integration tests, and app test, typecheck and build (scripts/validate.py --all). Use it when your change touches both the app (app/) and the backend (backend/, tests/, scripts/), or neither (docs, configuration).

test-backend.description: Run the backend test suites outside your sandbox: the unit suite and every integration module, without the app (scripts/validate.py --backend). Use it when your change touches only the backend (backend/, tests/) and nothing under app/.

test-ui.description: Run the app test suite outside your sandbox: npm test, typecheck and build for app/ (scripts/validate.py --ui). Use it when your change touches only the app (app/) and nothing in the backend, tests/ or scripts/.

test-touched.description: Quicker check while iterating: the unit suite plus the integration modules and app package your change touches (scripts/validate.py --touched). Does not count as the final test run.

test-unit.description: Fastest check: the backend unit suite only (scripts/validate.py --unit).
